name: Telluride Venture Network
evidence: TVN (Telluride Foundation initiative) ran a 2025 Climate Solutions Investment Bootcamp cohort of eight climate/cleantech startups (Green Steel Environmental, New Day Hydrogen, Sustainable Chemicals, EVchargeME, etc.) and hosts a recurring Pitch Day. Structured, cohort-based investor-readiness program.

name: Catalyst Accelerator
evidence: Defense/space accelerator (Catalyst Campus, Colorado Springs) running back-to-back cohorts: CADEW cohort held Demo Day Jan 15 2026 (15th cohort), and the 16th cohort (AI/ML Orchestrator for USSF Delta 7) began Jan 12 2026 with 6 companies; applications solicited Sept 2025.

name: Third Derivative
evidence: Climate-tech accelerator (RMI + New Energy Nexus) unveiled a new 26-startup, 13-country cohort focused on hard-tech deployment in May 2026; runs an 18-month structured accelerator with recurring cohorts. On-file domain redirects to www.third-derivative.org.

name: CanopyBoulder
evidence: Cannabis-ancillary accelerator (founded 2014, ~51 portfolio cos). On-file domain (www.canopyboulder.com and go.canopyboulder.com) no longer resolves/serves (connection timeout / SSL failure Aug 2026). No accelerator cohort announced since ~2019-2020; program appears wound down. Last Dealroom round 2019.

name: Fulcrum Venture Accelerator
evidence: Fundraising accelerator (founded 2019 by Will Sacks). On-file domain redirects to the rebranded fulcrumventures.io (same org). Ran its 7th 'Fundraising Mastery' cohort in mid-2023; 2024 was a consolidation year after which it moved to a bespoke (non-cohort) model. No cohort-based program signal since 2023.

name: CatalyzeCU
evidence: CU Boulder's equity-free summer student startup accelerator. On-file domain catalyzecu.com serves only a 'Hello World :-)' placeholder page, but the real active program lives at colorado.edu/catalyzecu with a 2025 cohort (applications March-April 2025, program mid-May to early August).

name: Unreasonable at Sea
evidence: One-off transnational entrepreneurship accelerator run aboard Semester at Sea; inaugural (and effectively only) voyage sailed Jan 2013 with 10 teams. On-file domain unreasonableatsea.org does not connect (Aug 2026); content now lives only as an archived initiative page under unreasonablegroup.com. Program discontinued.

name: Innosphere
evidence: Science/tech incubator (Fort Collins). Launched a 2025 Life Sciences Accelerator with 33 startups (national showcase Dec 2025) and announced its 2026 Life Sciences Incubator cohort in May 2026. Structured, cohort-based, active.

name: Startup Colorado
evidence: Rural-entrepreneur support network; primarily a peer network but runs structured cohort programming, including the Founder Coopetition / 'Idea Factory' four-week accelerator with weekly cohort sessions, and launched a Rural Angel Investor Network in 2025. More of a support network than a classic equity accelerator, so throughput is a rough estimate.
